# PackZen

> PackZen is a Bangalore (Bengaluru), India packers & movers and home-services company with fixed, upfront online prices. It also runs PackZen Digital, which builds websites for businesses. Bookings and payments happen online at https://packzenblr.in, with support by phone or WhatsApp on +91 99450 95453 (8 AM – 9 PM, every day).

## Services and starting prices (Bangalore)
- House shifting (1 RK to villas): from ₹2,150; a 1 BHK local move usually costs ₹4,200–₹6,500 and a 2 BHK ₹8,000–₹14,000. The exact fixed price is shown before booking: https://packzenblr.in/house-shifting-bangalore.html
- Mini move (up to 5 items, within 10 km, no packing): ₹1,499
- Office relocation: quoted per office: https://packzenblr.in/office-relocation-bangalore.html
- Packing and unpacking: https://packzenblr.in/packing-unpacking-services-bangalore.html
- Bike transport: https://packzenblr.in/bike-transport-bangalore.html
- AC service ₹429 per AC; AC repair visit ₹249; AC gas refill with leak check ₹2,399; AC installation ₹1,649 / uninstallation ₹799: https://packzenblr.in/ac-service-repair-bangalore.html
- Washing machine repair visit ₹249 (repair quoted on site); installation ₹449; uninstallation ₹299: https://packzenblr.in/washing-machine-repair-bangalore.html
- Refrigerator repair visit ₹249; refrigerator gas refill ₹1,999 with leak check: https://packzenblr.in/refrigerator-repair-bangalore.html
- For businesses: corporate employee relocation, shop and showroom shifting, PG and co-living services, AC and appliance maintenance: https://packzenblr.in/business.html
- Websites for businesses (PackZen Digital): Starter ₹7,999, Business ₹14,999, booking / online store from ₹29,999, care plan ₹999 per month: https://packzenblr.in/digital/

## Not offered
Two-wheeler parcel delivery, electrician / plumber / carpenter visits, TV wall mounting, painting and cleaning are not offered.

## Service area
All of Bangalore (every 560xxx pincode) plus Hoskote, Anekal, Devanahalli, Sarjapur and Attibele. Moves must start in Bangalore; destinations can be other cities (intercity moves are quoted per route).

## How booking works
1. Get an instant fixed price online (moves) or choose a service.
2. Book online and pay an advance or pay later; the balance is paid after the job.
3. A trained crew or technician arrives; the job is closed with the customer's completion code.
Offers: ₹200 off a first move above ₹4,000 with code FIRSTMOVE; 3% weekday saver on Tue–Thu moves between the 5th and 25th of the month.

- Damage cover up to ₹10,000 per booking under the policy.
